name: Ashiya Doman
source:
The Onmyouji who put the hex on Yura.
[spoiler]He meant to hex Gaku, but Gaku nearly died from the curse so Yura took it in his stead. Doman has also been physically dead for over one thousand years, and is residing in a vessel made of clay.[/spoiler]
